title: Committed 2MB Mach-O build artifact app.bin (new file mode 100755 in this chunk)
evidence:
diff --git a/app.bin b/app.bin
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..4aaf130
Binary files /dev/null and b/app.bin differ
$ git cat-file -s $(git rev-parse HEAD:app.bin)
2057480
$ head -c 16 app.bin | xxd
00000000: cffa edfe 0c00 0001 0000 0000 0200 0000  ................
# .gitignore (no rule matches app.bin):
bin/
goldens/_reports/
detail: 2MB Mach-O arm64 executable added by PR head commit 0118cc0; .gitignore ignores bin/ but not app.bin; PR body and README never state it is deliberate, so it bloats and platform-locks the repo.
recommended_fix: Remove app.bin from the commit and add an app.bin rule to .gitignore; README already documents `odin build app` as the build path.

title: Committed self-review reports (verification-gap.md, edge-case-hunter.md) contradict the reviewed commit — fixed items still reported as open
detail: These docs are committed as the current review record, yet describe the pre-fix codebase: an open blocker (B1) and several warnings (W4, upgrade unreachability, CI build gap, save exit) are verifiably fixed at this commit; future readers and Perkins rounds will treat them as current.
recommended_fix: Re-run or amend the two reports against the reviewed sha (mark each finding applied/carried, fix demo count), or move them out of the repo into _bmad-output.

title: data/crises.json is parsed and validated but its content is never consumed by the sim
detail: lead_time_ticks, preventive_redesign, root_cause_pattern load into cat.crises with zero readers, yet crises.json still feeds the catalog hash — editing it forces a re-bless with no behavioral effect. The committed edge-case-hunter N10 also misstates it as never parsed.
recommended_fix: Wire the parsed Crisis_Def into the crisis/forecast path (lead_time_ticks, preventive_redesign copy) or drop the fields from the catalog until a consumer exists.
